title: Warranty Coverage Claims Desk Standard: Claims Belong to the Registration Covering the Unit
content:
**Standard.** Under Warranty Coverage, claims are kept apart when a customer holds several registrations. A claim is filed and decided under the registration that covers the unit claimed, never under another registration of the same customer even if its plan is richer. Breakage claim counts, no-show counts, deductibles and charges belong to the registration and claim they arise on and are never pooled. One claim covers one component; problems with two components are two claims, and each approved glass breakage claim carries its own deductible.

## Authority and correlation

- The registration a claim belongs to is the one the claim record names, and that registration covers the unit through the window contract or door contract recorded on it. This is read from the system's records.
- The claim being decided is identified by its own claim record.

## Separation at a glance

| Item | Belongs to |
|---|---|
| A claim and its decision | the registration covering the unit claimed |
| Count of approved breakage claims | that registration |
| Count of missed visits | that registration |
| Deductibles and charges | the registration and the claim they arise on |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A customer holds a window registration under the Ridgeline Limited Warranty and a door registration under the Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty. A fogged window unit is claimed under the window registration's Ridgeline Limited Warranty, not under the richer door plan.
2. A broken handle and a failed seal on the same window are two components, so they are two claims.
3. Two approved glass breakage claims each carry their own deductible; one deductible never covers both.
4. A missed visit on the door registration is not counted toward missed visits on the window registration.
